resolved.resolution: Every non-particle vocable follows nuclear-clause structure; an English one-word translation does not turn the Nahuatl form into a word.
The predicate source selects VNC or NNC machinery; noun, adjective, and adverb predicates do not require an English copula or a duplicate clause-kind choice.
The formula is projected from the same typed nuclear-clause structure used by the canonical Result; interface labels and stored formulas cannot choose grammar.
The application preserves stem-centered VNC and NNC organizational layers instead of treating the Result as flat string joining.
Dyadic, monadic, or vacant valence or state selects one of the six formulas automatically; the user never chooses a formula number.
Pronouns remain affixal and case-bound; person, animacy, humanness, number, and context govern interpretation, while English gender has no Nahuatl grammar authority.
